DREAMS_BASE_RESTFUL_DREAM.why: Restful Dream is learned automatically with Dreams. Use it outside combat: a 10-minute ritual on one touched, willing creature costs 1 cultivation point from your Path resource. After that creature's next completed Short Rest, it gains Temporary HP equal to twice the caster's Proficiency Bonus, may repeat one Frightened save, may end one ordinary nightmare or minor sleep or mental-stress effect, and gains Advantage on one ordinary exhaustion, stress or mental-fatigue recovery check. A creature can benefit once per Long Rest. The journey menu performs the ritual and asks the recipient's optional choices.
